message:
This is a response to CB and others that fell victim to setting up an account with T-NETIX. File a complaint with your public utility commission. The process is lengthy but it has to be done. It has been 16 months since I filed my complaint with the Maryland Public Service Commission. The commission began ruling on my formal complaint the 1st week in June 2007. As of yet there has not been a decision. It is important that everyone do this first, by filing a complaint with the utility T-NETIX will be forced to respond directly to you and at that point you will learn how they operate and then you can challenge them for what they have done to you.

Your can read about my current formal complaint with T-NETIX that the Maryland Public Service Commission has put online. Just google this search by typing in Elvera Williams v T-NETIX formal complaint and it will come up.
I guarantee that everyone will learn a whole lot by reading this and you will understand just how to challenge them.

I gather that everyone has been assigned a credit limit by them and this is your first time learning about it. An account can be established when a person calls from the local jail and then when they go on to prison you have an account with CBS that you know nothing about.
